title: 66,386 Shares in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Acquired by Highland Associates Inc.
text:
Posted by John. R. Edwardson on Jan 29th, 2019 // No Comments
Highland Associates Inc. bought a new position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) during the 3rd quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The fund bought 66,386 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $14,986,000. Apple accounts for approximately 2.3% of Highland Associates Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 8th largest holding.
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Culbertson A N & Co. Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 1.7% in the third quarter. Culbertson A N & Co. Inc. now owns 80,732 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $18,224,000 after buying an additional 1,321 shares in the last quarter. Truvestments Capital LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 13.1% in the third quarter. Truvestments Capital LLC now owns 25,602 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $5,779,000 after buying an additional 2,963 shares in the last quarter. FCA Corp TX boosted its stake in Apple by 114.4% in the third quarter. FCA Corp TX now owns 5,642 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,273,000 after buying an additional 3,011 shares in the last quarter. IFM Investors Pty Ltd boosted its stake in Apple by 12.9% in the third quarter. IFM Investors Pty Ltd now owns 259,608 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $58,604,000 after buying an additional 29,756 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Summit Financial Wealth Advisors LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 3.9% in the third quarter. Summit Financial Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 15,250 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,314,000 after buying an additional 567 shares in the last quarter. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink . 0.05% of the stock is owned by company insiders. Shares of AAPL opened at $156.30 on Tuesday. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $142.00 and a 1 year high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The stock has a market cap of $775.41 billion, a PE ratio of 13.12, a P/E/G ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same period last year, the company earned $2.07 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. On average, research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.88 EPS for the current fiscal year.
Several research firms recently weighed in on AAPL. Oppenheimer reaffirmed a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research note on Monday, October 1st. Vertical Group assumed coverage on Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a “sell” rating on the stock. Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, October 9th. Finally, Citigroup lifted their price target on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday, October 8th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.33.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
